genuine_additions.question: During standard setup, must human Leaders be distributed at random, or may the players choose them?
genuine_additions.answer: Each player takes a Leader and places it in front of them; Leaders may be chosen or selected at random. Shaddam remains subject to the CHOAM restriction already tested in Q21.
genuine_additions.novelty: An actual setup permission not requested anywhere in the 93-question bank. Q21 explicitly requests selection/distribution of Objective cards and only the Shaddam restriction for Leaders. Q44 requests particular Leader initial states; Q84 requests deck and component preparation; neither asks how Leaders are selected. Choosing versus compulsory random assignment is a different source rule from random Objective distribution, not changed names or numbers in an existing branch.
genuine_additions.scope_note: This addition does not treat story/complexity recommendations as compulsory rules.

genuine_additions.question: When an ordinary draw-a-card effect resolves, which deck supplies the card? May you choose a card directly from your discard pile instead?
genuine_additions.answer: Draw from your own deck. You do not choose a card directly from your discard pile; when the deck is empty and a draw is needed, reshuffle the discard pile into a new deck and continue drawing.
genuine_additions.novelty: The ordinary draw icon has an explicit card origin. Q23/Q80 request when round-start draws happen; Q39 requests during/after-Reveal timing; Q34 requests when reshuffling occurs. None requests which deck an ordinary draw effect uses. Q78 requests Intrigue deck versus opponent origins, a different draw mechanism. Existing board-space effects questions request that a card is drawn, but not the ordinary draw source or permission to select from discard. Only this origin is claimed as new; the reshuffle explanation repeats Q34 to make the answer usable.
